{{Quote|This is Chief Rannos, of Republic SIS. I've been looking over your files. Obviously, I'm impressed.|Rannos|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Rannos''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] agent of the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] who held the position of [[Chief/Legends|Chief]] during the [[Galactic War]]. When the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]] was overtaken by an [[Tion Hegemony rakghoul outbreak|outbreak]] of the [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|rakghoul plague]], Rannos grew concerned and dispatched his operative [[Whisper (Cathar)|Whisper]] to recruit Republic operatives. He later led the Republic [[Mission to the Lost Island|assault]] on [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Sannus Lorrick]]'s [[Lost Island]]<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Chief Rannos introduces Republic players to the Kaon Under Siege Flashpoint, which was added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in Game Update 1.1.<ref name="TOR" /> He is voiced by [[Fred Tatasciore]].
